item.title: The US government just pulled Fable 5 offline
item.description: Four days. That’s how long Claude Fable 5 was generally available before the US government ordered it offline. On June 11, 2026, Anthropic announced it received an export control directive, citing national security authorities, to suspend all access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5 by any foreign national, inside or outside the United States, including Anthropic’s own foreign national employees. Since there’s no practical way to verify the nationality of every user, the net effect is that both models are now disabled for everyone. All other Claude models keep running.
